briefdescription.para: Spawns a detached end --nexus <uuid> daemon process.

detaileddescription.para: Reads the current executable path, spawns a child with --nexus <uuid> in a new session (POSIX) or as a detached process (Windows), then returns immediately. The child inherits no file descriptors (stdin/stdout/stderr redirected to /dev/null on POSIX, or default DETACHED_PROCESS on Windows).

briefdescription.para: Removes all sessions and triggers daemon shutdown.

detaileddescription.para: Removes all sessions.
Iterates all live sessions via nexus.list(), calls nexus.remove() for each, then fires onAllSessionsExited to trigger the existing quit path.

NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
Snapshots the session list via nexus.list() before iterating so that each nexus.remove() call does not invalidate the iterator. Shutdown is triggered by the last nexus.remove() firing valueTreeChildRemoved on this Daemon, which detects the empty list and calls systemRequestedQuit().

briefdescription.para: Wires daemon-mode IPC callbacks on a newly created terminal::Session.

detaileddescription.para:
Wires daemon-mode exit handling via a ValueTree::Listener on the session State:
broadcasts sessionKilled to all attached connections,
removes the session from Nexus,
re-broadcasts the sessions list,
fires onAllSessionsExited if empty.
Also wires onBytes to broadcast output PDUs to per-session subscribers. State updates (cwd, foregroundProcess) are broadcast via valueTreePropertyChanged.

parameterdescription.para: UUID of the session (used in closures for routing).

briefdescription.para: Reacts to session creation on Nexus::events.

detaileddescription.para: Called when a "SESSION" child is appended to nexus.events. Wires daemon-mode IPC callbacks on the newly created session.

NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
When a "SESSION" child is appended to nexus.events, wires daemon-mode IPC callbacks on the newly created session via wireSessionCallbacks.

briefdescription.para: Reacts to session removal on Nexus::events.

detaileddescription.para: When the last "SESSION" child is removed from nexus.events, triggers daemon shutdown by deleting the nexus file and calling systemRequestedQuit().

NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD.
When the last "SESSION" child is removed from nexus.events, cleans up the nexus file and triggers application shutdown. This replaces the onAllSessionsExited callback.

briefdescription.para: Creates and installs a Windows Job Object so child processes are killed when the daemon process exits.

detaileddescription.para: Windows: creates a Job Object with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE and assigns the current process to it. Stores the handle in jobObject. POSIX: no-op.

briefdescription.para: Releases the Job Object handle acquired by installPlatformProcessCleanup().

detaileddescription.para: Windows: closes the Job Object handle and resets jobObject to nullptr. POSIX: no-op.

briefdescription.para: Detects shellExited and cwd/foregroundProcess changes on registered session State VTs.

detaileddescription.para: shellExited: Checks for a PARAM node whose id property equals terminal::id::shellExited with value 1. Matches the tree's root against sessionStateRoots to find the exiting UUID. Cleanup is deferred via callAsync to avoid mutating session state from within the ValueTree listener callback chain.

cwd / foregroundProcess: Direct properties on the session root (TEXT parameters). Broadcasts a stateUpdate PDU to per-session subscribers when either changes. juce::ValueTree fires valueTreePropertyChanged only when the value actually changes, so no additional dedup is required.

briefdescription.para: InterprocessConnectionServer that creates Channel objects and owns the broadcast and per-session subscriber registries.

detaileddescription.para: Owned by ENDApplication. start() calls beginWaitingForSocket(), writes the bound port to AppModel (persisted to the nexus state file), and caches it in activePort. stop() calls the base InterprocessConnectionServer::stop(). Nexus port file deletion is handled by AppModel::deleteNexusFile() on quit.

simplesect.title: Thread context
simplesect.para: start() / stop() — NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD. createConnectionObject() — NEXUS PROCESS LISTENER THREAD (called by base class). attach / detach / broadcastSessions / subscriber methods — MESSAGE THREAD.
